strapiBlog.title: OMNIYAT Acquires Marasi Bay Island With a Plan to Open Beach Club in Burj Khalifa District
strapiBlog.short_description: OMNIYAT has officially acquired Marasi Bay Island, a high-profile reclamation project set to evolve into a standout destination for luxury living and leisure in the Burj Khalifa District.

data.text:
OMNIYAT has officially acquired Marasi Bay Island, a high-profile reclamation project set to evolve into a standout destination for luxury living and leisure in the Burj Khalifa District. The project introduces the first-ever OMNIYAT beach club in the Burj Khalifa area and reimagines the bay as a premier lifestyle hub. 

Marasi Bay Dubai will offer unparalleled connectivity to iconic hubs such as Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Business Bay, D3 Design District, and Dubai International Airport. The development encapsulates OMNIYAT's vision of crafting exceptional spaces for ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNWIs), with a mix of opulent residences, wellness hubs, hospitality, and leisure venues.

Marasi Bay Island - An Overview

Marasi Bay Island is OMNIYAT’s visionary waterfront development, transforming a reclaimed site into an ultra-luxury lifestyle destination in the heart of Dubai. Situated within the iconic Burj Khalifa District, the project blends high-end residential living, premium hospitality, world-class wellness, and unique leisure experiences into one seamless urban retreat.

Featuring OMNIYAT’s first beach club in the area, a private floating park, and a superyacht marina, the development sets a new benchmark for waterfront living tailored to the world’s most discerning residents and investors.

data.text:
World-Class Amenities for an Elevated Lifestyle

As the vision for the OMNIYAT Marasi Bay Island takes shape, the development is introducing a series of curated features designed exclusively for residents. Key highlights include a 30,000-square-foot floating island linked to the waterfront promenade, offering:

  • Sensory and meditation gardens
  • Yoga terrace
  • Picnic lawns
  • Dog park
  • Private dining areas with chef’s kitchen and BBQ zones
  • Flexible indoor spaces for work and events

The development will also house OMNIYAT beach club Beach Club in Burj Khalifa District. This first of its kind club will blend white-sand beachfront relaxation with exclusive resident services.

Marasi Bay Marina, operated by OMNIYAT and located on the bay’s south side, brings together a range of premium maritime amenities. It features berths for superyachts, a private Yacht Club, tender boat services, and jetty lounges that serve both boat owners and guests of The Lana Hotel. A key highlight is the Signature Pavilion, a 10,000-square-foot over-water retail and event space designed to host upscale experiences.

Additional amenities along the waterfront promenade include private jetty drop-offs, indoor event and coworking spaces, a padel court, children's play areas, a running track, and a curated art trail—further enriching the community-centric and active lifestyle envisioned for Marasi Bay.

This diverse blend of offerings makes this OMNIYAT's new project in Dubai more than a residential development—it’s a complete lifestyle experience, built to foster wellbeing, leisure, and community in a lush waterfront environment.

Signature Luxury Developments at Marasi Bay Island

At the architectural heart of Marasi Bay lies the OMINIYAT Vela Viento tower, part of the Dorchester Collection, Dubai. Towering at 180 meters, Vela Viento is an architectural marvel designed by Foster + Partners.

The tower houses 95 exclusive residences, many featuring terrace pools, suspended dining rooms, and panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa and waterfront. Interiors by Gilles & Boissier and optional custom designs by Banda Studio elevate these homes to the epitome of urban luxury.

Residents will enjoy the Sky Amenities Deck positioned over 100 meters high, offering a double-height gym, infinity pool, yoga studio, and private lounges. Ground-level features include spas, meeting rooms, indoor pools, and direct promenade access to The Lana Hotel—OMNIYAT’s other architectural gem under the Dorchester Collection brand. This curated residential experience is seamlessly tied into the broader OMNIYAT Marasi Bay Island master plan.

A major highlight of the Marasi Bay ecosystem is The Lana Hotel and Residences, inaugurated in Q1 2024. It is the first Dorchester Collection hotel in the Middle East, showcasing the region’s only Dior Spa. Setting a new standard in luxury, the penthouse sale at The Lana set a record as the most expensive property ever sold in the Burj Khalifa District as of May 2024.

Adding a commercial edge to the luxury canvas, OMNIYAT new project Dubai, ENARA by OMNIYAT, is set for completion in 2027. This ultra-premium office tower, with direct promenade and jetty access to VELA, VELA Viento, and The Lana, aims to attract the global business elite. Offering luxury offices, fine dining curated by global chefs, and outdoor wellness facilities, ENARA transforms the commercial landscape of Marasi Bay.

The ongoing Marasi Bay Island development promises more than just luxury—it offers a lifestyle ecosystem curated by the world's finest minds in architecture, design, hospitality, and art. With each project, OMNIYAT continues to shape the future of waterfront living in Dubai, making Marasi Bay Dubai a name synonymous with elevated urban luxury.

faqs.question: What makes OMNIYAT Marasi Bay Island unique?

data.answer: It’s the first development in the Burj Khalifa District to feature a beach club, private floating park, and superyacht marina, all curated for ultra-high-net-worth individuals.

faqs.question: When will ENARA by OMNIYAT be completed?

data.answer: ENARA, the luxury office tower in Marasi Bay, is set for completion in 2027.

faqs.question: Is the beach club open to the public?

data.answer: No, the beach club and most other amenities are exclusively available to OMNIYAT residents.

faqs.question: How is Marasi Bay connected to other parts of Dubai?

data.answer: It is centrally located with seamless access to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, D3, and Dubai International Airport, connected by promenades and waterways.
